fields.Name: IT86 - Transaction Group Batched Submit
fields.Description: Live-DB proof of the OPT-IN batched TransactionGroup submit (BatchedSubmit), which the unit tier can only assert against mocks. TGB1 reads SQL Server's own plan cache to confirm the group reached the server as ONE sentinel-fenced statement; TGB2 pins per-item result mapping through a real driver (3 items, 3 distinct server ids, each mapped to its own row); TGB3 pins that the global @p renumbering binds per-item values to their own items (quote / unicode / wildcard payloads); TGB4 pins failure atomicity inside one batched statement; TGB5 is a differential check that batched and sequential submits are observably identical. Server transport (BatchedSubmit is a property of the server-built group). SQL Server only; skips-as-pass elsewhere and where the plan-cache DMVs are unreadable. Self-cleaning prefixed fixtures.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: The batched submit reaches SQL Server as one sentinel-fenced statement, maps every item's result back to its own item, binds every item's parameters to its own row, fails as a unit on a poison item, and is observably identical to the sequential path. 5 checks (TGB1-TGB5).
